instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this guideline strictly for creating the Delhi Apostille live preview in React.
Ensure every interactive button, input, link, tab, modal, and item has explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-quote-submit-btn', data-testid='whatsapp-float-btn').
Avoid generic bright purple/violet gradients. Use deep institutional navy (#0A192F), soft warm ivory (#FAF8F5), and notary gold (#C5A44E) accents.
Ensure the header navigation is sticky with a non-transparent backdrop filter and high contrast links.
Build a rich multi-step or dynamic quote calculator (Select Document Type -> Select Department/Country -> Instant Estimate & Free Consultation Request).
Include schema-friendly FAQ accordions and authority department matrices to mirror an SEO-first WordPress site structure.
